newsitem.title: UK: FTSE 100 opens firm, led by retailers, Wall Street.
newsitem.headline: FTSE 100 opens firm, led by retailers, Wall Street.

text.p: Leading British shares opened higher on Friday in a broad-based rally tied to a further rise in retailers and healthy overnight gains in the Dow, dealers said.
By 0750 GMT the FTSE 100 index was 28.0 points higher at 4,795,8, with advancers leading decliners 92 to seven.
The mid-cap FTSE 250, heavily influenced by industrial companies, gained 7.2 points to 4,393.4.
A sharply higher open in futures prices also lifted the FTSE 100. September FTSE futures gained 54 points to 4,833.0.
